svg.title: Common Ledger — original editable vector artboard, fictional data
svg.desc: Vector export of an original HTML interface study. Text remains text; charts and symbols remain vector paths. Import into Figma as SVG. This is not a native Figma source file or component library.
svg.text: A clear view of what moved, what settled,
and what still needs your attention.
Gross receipts by day. Refunds are excluded.
A SMALL NOTE FOR A CLEANER CLOSE.
